items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: He held my hand and showed me the second position... He said, now, well, what I want you to do now, he says, go down and buy your method. He says, come up here twice a week. He says, I'm going to give you this.

ctx.x: I think you might give your name first. Albert Warner. Any middle name? No, any middle name. Born

New Orleans, Louisiana. December 31st, 1890. I first started learning music with a half-brother mine. He learned from Honoré Dutré. Well, when he left, before he left, he bought him a new trombone. And a boy wanted to buy his old trombone from him. And he refused to sell it to him. He paid one against his brother. Well, he sent downtown, got me, and I went on up to his house to see what it was all about. I got there. He gave me this little old brass horn with about a bell the size of a saucer.
